full_prompt_en: A square Japanese-style silk painting depicts a tall white crane standing among peonies and branching foliage on a warm ochre ground. The crane occupies the center, facing left with its long narrow beak and gracefully curved neck. Its body is a broad ivory form filled with individually drawn layered feathers; deep blue-black wing and tail feathers fall along the right side. Thin dark legs stand on a gnarled root or low branch near the bottom. A full white peony opens below and left of the bird, and another rises above its back to the upper right. A muted rust-red bloom peeks through the leaves at far right. Deep teal foliage and brown branches twist across the image, some passing behind the crane and others forming a low tangled base. The ochre background remains visible in wide spaces around the bird, giving its pale feathers room to glow. At the left margin, a slim column of calligraphic marks and small red seal impressions sits within the painting, modest rather than headline-sized. The entire surface has an aged woven-paper or silk grain, and colors appear slightly absorbed into it. Brushwork is controlled and meticulous: thin dark lines trace feather edges, veins, stems, and petals, while soft washes add shadow inside white flowers and under the crane's wings. The palette is restrained—ivory, ochre, teal green, dark indigo, brown, and small rust-red details. Light is even and symbolic rather than coming from a visible direction; the crane and blossoms are bright because of preserved pale pigment against a darker ground, with little cast shadow. The composition is poised and decorative, a calm vertical figure held among curling branches and two large pale flower anchors.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形日本风格绢画描绘一只高白鹤立在暖赭色底上的牡丹与分枝叶丛间。白鹤居中，面向左侧，喙长而细，颈部优雅弯曲。身体是宽阔象牙白形体，内部每层羽毛逐片细绘；深蓝黑翅羽与尾羽沿右侧垂下。细深腿站在底部附近一段弯曲树根或低枝上。一朵盛开的白牡丹在鸟的左下，另一朵在背后升到右上。最右处，暗锈红花从叶间露出。深青绿叶与棕枝在画里扭转，有些穿过白鹤后方，有些在下部构成纠缠根基。鸟身周围的宽阔空处仍可见赭色背景，让浅色羽毛发亮。左边缘一列细瘦书法笔痕和几枚小红印章位于画内，尺寸克制，并非标题文字。整个表面带旧织纸或绢的颗粒，颜色似乎略渗入其中。笔触受控精密：细暗线描羽边、叶脉、茎与花瓣，柔和水洗色在白花内部和鹤翅下添影。配色克制——象牙、赭、青绿、深靛蓝、棕和少量锈红。光均匀且带象征性，不来自可见方向；白鹤和花朵之所以亮，是因为较深底上保留的浅色颜料，几乎没有投影。构图从容而装饰性强，一道平静竖向形体被卷曲枝条与两处大型浅花锚点围住。
style_prompt_en: A meticulous silk-and-ink painting treatment rests controlled linework and absorbent color washes on a warm ochre textured ground. An ivory central vertical mass is articulated with many small repeated featherlike arcs and balanced by two broad pale rounded clusters. Dark teal, indigo, and brown branching lines loop around the pale areas, with small rust-red touches and narrow side marks adding restrained accents. Wide portions of background remain unpainted enough to show woven grain. Fine contour lines define edges, but internal values shift through thin transparent washes rather than heavy shading. The arrangement is shallow and decorative, with organic curves creating a measured frame around the central form. Illumination is even and non-directional; brightness arises from pale pigment against ochre, not a beam or cast shadow. The composition feels quiet, formal, and highly observant, balancing dense detailed tracery against generous warm ground.
style_prompt_zh: 精密绢墨绘画处理让受控线描与吸水洗色落在有纹理的暖赭底上。中央象牙白竖向体量由许多重复的小羽片般弧线细分，并由两团宽阔浅色圆形簇群平衡。深青绿、靛蓝与棕色分枝线绕着浅色区域回旋，少量锈红点缀与狭窄侧边记号增加克制重点。背景大面积保留未完全涂满，显出织纹。细轮廓线定义边缘，内部明度却通过薄透明水洗变化，而非厚重阴影。布局浅而装饰性强，有机弯线在中央形体周围形成有分寸的框架。照明均匀且无方向；亮度来自赭色前的浅颜料，而非束光或投影。构图安静、正式且观察细致，在密集细描线网与宽裕暖底之间平衡。
theme_en: A white crane among peonies and dark teal foliage on aged ochre silk
theme_zh: 旧赭色绢面上，白鹤立在牡丹与深青绿叶丛之间
name: Ito Jakuchu
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
